authority: User requests continue R17 implementation and close real discovery gaps, preserving commercial and external-action gates
objectives: Reproduce and fix fetch enqueue policy checks losing the normalized-domain request used by exact S01 scope matching

Allow an explicitly requested server approval mode for ordinary customer requests: resolve only unambiguous current approvals from the trusted server registry, preserve legacy explicit-reference behavior
Do not invent rights expiration, approvals, scope, evidence or permissions; retain every existing gate before DNS, fetch or worker scheduling
Prove persistence, domain/search scope binding, expired/missing/ambiguous approval rejection, worker unavailability and remote-disabled behavior on synthetic fixtures
interface: approvalMode:'server' is optional; existing requests with explicit approvalReferences retain their behavior. Server mode must not accept client-selected approval references simultaneously. Return useful blocked reasons without exposing private approval evidence. Source rights still need a user-supplied valid expiry; customer UI is owned separately.
constraints: No environment or provider flag enablement outside scoped sandbox tests
